picks.title: Datadog veterans launch AI coding startup Niteshift on a bet against Big AI lock-in
picks.why_it_matters: Strong founder pedigree (Datadog exits) entering the red-hot AI coding agent space with a differentiated thesis around model portability—signals both investor appetite and a potential wedge against incumbent AI platforms.

picks.title: Jedify raises $24M to help companies arm AI agents with context on their business
picks.why_it_matters: Significant seed/Series A round in the emerging AI agent infrastructure layer, with strategic backing from Snowflake signaling enterprise demand for context management as agentic AI deployments scale.

picks.title: Anthropic CEO says government should block dangerous AI
picks.why_it_matters: Amodei publicly advocating for regulatory intervention signals potential compliance moats forming around AI safety—early-stage founders building in AI should anticipate regulatory overhead becoming a market shaping force.
